scope: Supplemental teaching routines for the existing classroom requirements; no teacher target is replaced or removed.

resources.subject: ELA
resources.title: Focused Reading and Viewing Guide
resources.creator: NCTE / ReadWriteThink
resources.access: Public one-page PDF read in full; no Flash required
resources.use: Complete a text / medium / effect chart using the assigned pair; close both sources and explain one comparison with evidence.
resources.boundary: The original is a Grades 3–5 story organizer. The local Grade 6 extension requires evidence, author purpose, and effect; assigned Reading Buddies and Goodall materials still control.

resources.subject: MATH
resources.title: Number Line: Integers
resources.creator: PhET, University of Colorado Boulder
resources.access: Official page recovered; simulation bundle is too large for text retrieval; external execution is optional
resources.use: Predict the positions of -6 and -2, inspect the model, then close it and distinguish order from magnitude. A local number-line model supplies the same core practice.
resources.boundary: Does not establish Big Eight recall, fraction plotting, coordinate reflection, or independent mastery.

resources.subject: SCI
resources.title: Creating Chains and Webs to Model Ecological Relationships
resources.creator: HHMI BioInteractive
resources.access: Official activity and seven-page student worksheet recovered
resources.use: Use the card-and-arrow method with a small food web; change one factor and defend a prediction. Return to the teacher's salt-marsh examples.
resources.boundary: Original resource is high-school level. Only the food-web construction and disturbance method is used; extra high-school calculations are not assigned. Local organism cards are original practice examples.

resources.subject: SCI
resources.title: Wolf Sheep Predation
resources.creator: Uri Wilensky / Northwestern University CCL
resources.access: Model documentation read in full; optional NetLogo Web launch requires JavaScript
resources.use: Choose sheep-wolves-grass, compare the default run with a slower grass-regrowth setting, repeat, and explain changes using recorded evidence.
resources.boundary: A simplified stochastic model, not measured salt-marsh data. Numerical outcomes vary. External execution has not been verified on Riley's device.

resources.subject: SS
resources.title: Study Guide for Ancient Israel Test
resources.creator: Riley's teacher
resources.kind: maps, sequence cards, and recall prompts
resources.access: Original photographed 24-line guide reread and visually checked
resources.use: Reconstruct a map, attach cause and result to each route, then retrieve each teacher target in order with notes hidden.
resources.boundary: Local maps are relative-location study schematics, not scale maps or the teacher's original artwork.

resources.subject: MATH
resources.title: Coordinate Plane Song: 4 Quadrant Version
resources.creator: NUMBEROCK
resources.access: Official lesson description verified; some worksheets and extras require membership
resources.use: Use x-first/y-second cue, then plot rational coordinates and explain reflections with the resource closed.
resources.boundary: The earlier pl9nSVzRWvA link is Math with Mr. J's worked lesson, not NUMBEROCK. The link is corrected to the actual creator page.

resources.subject: MATH
resources.title: 11.1 Use the Rectangular Coordinate System
resources.creator: OpenStax / Rice University
resources.access: Official coordinate sections and examples read October28
resources.use: Study the labeled coordinate example, close it, then draw two new points on a half-unit grid and explain their horizontal or vertical distance.
resources.boundary: Later equation sections exceed this task. Integer-grid examples alone do not teach fractional grid scale; local half-unit examples repair that omission.

resources.subject: SCI
resources.title: Biosphere
resources.creator: National Geographic Society
resources.use: Read the opening definition, close the article, and distinguish a biotic organism, local ecosystem and biosphere with new examples.
resources.boundary: Article uses produce energy colloquially; organisms convert energy, not create it. Does not replace exact classroom vocabulary.

resources.subject: ELA
resources.title: 55 Years at Gombe: Q&A with Jane on Origins of Life Work
resources.creator: Jane Goodall Institute
resources.use: Compare the interview explanation of discovery with paragraphs38-39 of the assigned memoir; close both and explain how evidence supports significance.
resources.boundary: Supplemental interview, not the assigned memoir or unavailable teacher guide. Historical claims should be tied to the observation context.

excluded.reason: Official program homepage says the program is permanently closed; old listings are not reliable launch evidence.
Do not require obsolete Flash tools. Use the accessible PDF or local text chart instead.
Full object page returned 403. Indexed metadata alone is not a recovered source; no new classroom claim depends on it.
